name: OpenGrow Stake Electronics Clamp v1
purpose: Attach a small sensor or controller plate to a nominal 12 mm plant stake in a sheltered growing environment.

features.notes: Axis is parallel to Z; nominal diametral clearance is 0.6 mm over a 12 mm stake.
Minimum wall surrounding the stake bore before transition geometry.
Open radial split allows compliant installation onto the stake.
Flat plate is integrated tangentially with the clamp body.
Hole axes are parallel to Y and centers are separated along Z.
Separate routing feature through the mounting plate.
Blend the mounting plate into the clamp body.

mating_requirements.notes: Clearance is diametral and remains an initial digital benchmark target until measured physically.

load_cases.name: Preliminary radial service load
load_cases.description: Static lateral load applied at the mounting plate as an initial design input, not a verified capacity claim.
load_cases.direction: radial from the stake axis toward the mounting plate

assembly_method: Flex the split clamp over the stake, then attach the electronics plate or board with two M3 fasteners.
preferred_orientation: Stake axis parallel to build Z with the integrated mounting plate contributing bed contact.
surface_requirements: Stake bore and mounting holes must contain no generated support contact.
The electronics mounting face must be planar in the CAD model.
assumptions: The 12 mm stake is sufficiently round and its actual diameter will be measured before physical qualification.
The 10 N load is a preliminary benchmark input and is not a statement of proven strength.
The 12 month lifetime is a design target and has not been physically qualified.
The first CAD revision will orient the stake axis parallel to Z and avoid generated supports.
Food contact, electrical enclosure certification, and outdoor UV lifetime are outside this benchmark.
notes: Frozen M1 input for deterministic CAD and validation work. Passing this specification establishes R0 only.
